text: N276135June 22, 2016CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:356CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6105.20.2010; 6105.20.2030Ms. Karen PaitsellAugusta Sportswear425 Park West Drive Grovetown, GA  30813  RE:	The tariff classification of men’s and boys’ shirts from Mexico.   Dear Ms. Paitsell:In your letter dated May 6, 2016, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  As requested, your sample will be returned. The submitted sample, Style 1552 “Stanza Jersey,” is a men’s shirt constructed from 100% polyester, finely knit fabric that measures 16 stitches per linear centimeter counted in the horizontal direction and 21 stitches per linear centimeter counted in the vertical direction. Style 1552 has a contrasting color baseball neckline and placket; a left-over-right, partial front opening with two button closures; short, hemmed,  raglan sleeves; contrasting color piping at the raglan sleeve seams; contrasting color inserts at the top portion of each sleeve end; and a straight, hemmed bottom. Style 1552 will be imported in men’s (Adult) sizes S - 3XL. You state that the same garment will be imported as Style 1553 in boys’ (Youth) sizes S - L.   The applicable subheading for Style 1552 will be 6105.20.2010, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for: men’s or boys’ shirts, of man-made fibers: other: men’s. The duty rate will be 32% ad valorem.The applicable subheading for Style 1553 will be 6105.20.2030, HTSUS, which provides for: men’s or boys’ shirts, of man-made fibers: other: boys’: other. The duty rate will be 32% ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change. The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported. If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Maryalice Nowak at maryalice.nowak@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Deborah C. MarinucciActing DirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
